reviewer: Codex, personal complete-final-answer read; no paid judge
primary_route: Direct permeability reconstitution, conductance/single-vesicle corroboration and a cellular abundance/cleavage bridge; conditional cofactor discovery.

checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation and transfer check of prior primary Methods, supplements or validated protocols; local validation and acknowledging absent packet methods do not by themselves satisfy this action.

Core protein preparation/cleavage and lipid formulation/buffer conditions remain unresolved lists rather than a quantitative preparation-to-intervention workflow or a concrete source/calibration-to-setting procedure. Proposed protein concentration series alone does not specify the essential reconstitution.
Calibration lists measurements but gives no fluorescence-interference recovery or quantitative acceptance-to-action rule for the central leak/electrical assays.

Independent preparations and a pilot are recognized, but no quantitative power/precision target with an effect/variance-to-sample-size decision is supplied; a proposed three/six-preparation floor is not a justified confirmatory sample size.
Technical stops are qualitative and no registered attrition/denominator or bounded confirmatory stopping policy retains every originally assigned preparation.

The main contrast and model are named, but model assumptions/diagnostics and a fully specified uncertainty/multiplicity procedure for the panel are incomplete. Naming a mixed model is not sufficient execution detail.
A concentration/lipid/time range is proposed without a bounded ladder or concrete derivation of bounds, an objective selection criterion and a lock before independent confirmation.
Troubleshooting does not explicitly delimit permitted changes, refreeze the revised procedure and require fresh independent confirmation after such changes.

checks.quote: A cofactor should be called a required executioner only if
checks.reason: Rescue of biochemical activity plus cellular necessity and preserved cleavage establishes a required cofactor, not that the cofactor itself executes membrane injury. A regulator of GSDMD meets all these listed conditions. Later caution does not supply the missing executor-versus-enabler experiment.
No complete raw-unit-to-output audit trail with sample identifiers, exact analysis versions/settings and preserved failed/excluded runs is specified.

The primary direct-permeability question and competing indirect/artifact hypotheses are valuable. Identity/cleavage verification, fragment/caspase/buffer controls and quantitative abundance matching are prospectively specified. Main conclusions remain limited to tested permeability rather than precise pore architecture; the separate cofactor decision error is charged only at P13.

explanation_reason: Useful controlled direct-permeability study, but no pore-versus-rupture decision and an overly strong cofactor-executor decision. Several execution and audit requirements remain generic.
historical_match_reason: Question and direct membrane mechanism and purified-fragment intervention align. Readouts establish leakage, membrane injury and generic conductance, explicitly leaving physical lesion architecture unresolved; there is no operational combined pore-versus-nonspecific-rupture decision or corresponding pore-specific prediction. This earns scientific credit for a valid precursor study, not a qualified full pore-discovery hit.
